    "excerpt_original": "The effort became the foundation of Luke's AI Task Force, a team built to explore how artificial intelligence could reshape daily operations, preserve institutional knowledge and give Airmen more time to focus on the human elements of the mission.",
    "excerpt_zh": "这项工作成为卢克AI工作队的基石，该团队旨在探索人工智能如何重塑日常运营、保存机构知识，并让飞行员有更多时间专注于任务中的人为因素。",
    "normalized_claim": "卢克空军基地的这项工作成为该基地AI工作队的基石，该团队旨在探索AI在基地日常运营中的应用。",

  {
    "source_id": "T1-DAF-007",
    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0005",
    "excerpt_original": "A base-wide survey, which received over 170 responses, revealed a consistent theme: while many Airmen recognize AI's growing importance, many feel uncertain on how to use it effectively and within approved guidelines.",

  {
    "source_id": "T1-DAF-007",
    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0005",
    "excerpt_original": "Some Airmen are already using AI to draft emails, summarize information, analyze data and reduce repetitive administrative tasks, while others remain unsure what tools are authorized or how to apply them in a mission context.",

    "source_id": "T1-DAF-007",
    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0007",
    "excerpt_original": "Instead of just studying AI, the team decided to put it into practice. Members built tools, analyzed survey data and explored how emerging technology could support training, administration and decision-making processes.",

    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0007",
    "excerpt_original": "The team also explored how AI could help preserve institutional knowledge, capturing experience that is often lost as Airmen transition out of the service and preserving knowledge for the next generation of warfighters.",
    "excerpt_zh": "团队还探索了AI如何帮助保存机构知识，捕捉飞行员退役时经常丢失的经验，并为下一代作战人员保留知识。",
